ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability fit. The query is a creative brainstorming/fan-pairing task, and Petrel-235B leads on the relevant Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 78.8 — above the 2.0-point variance threshold) and on broad benchmarks like Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), which track open-ended generation quality. Since the content is benign and not moderation-related, neither model's trust-and-safety specialization was a deciding factor, so I defaulted to the stronger creative performer.
